{'id': '7da0ec66', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './skills/tau2Airline/SKILL.md'}, 'tool_output': '---\nname: tau2Airline\ndescription: Airline customer service agent — book, modify, and cancel flight reservations, and handle refunds and compensation.\n---\n\n## Dependencies\n\nRun once at the start of each session before calling any tools:\n\n```\nuv pip install addict deepdiff docstring-parser python-dotenv toml pyyaml pydantic loguru typing-extensions\n```\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\nAll tool logic lives in `src/tau2/domains/airline/tools.py`. State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. This skill owns the flights and\n# flight_bookings tagged `source_skill = \'tau2Airline\'` plus the users whose\n# `skill_ids_json` names this skill. `FlightDB.load()` builds the nested tree from\n# that scoped slice; `FlightDB.save()` writes mutations back. Override the DB path\n# with CUGA_WORLD_DB.\n\nSOURCE_SKILL = "tau2Airline"\nDB_PATH_ENV = "CUGA_WORLD_DB"\n\n# world.db `users.loyalty_tier` uses a shared vocabulary; tau2 membership is a\n# closed set. "standard" (the shared default) is tau2\'s "regular".\n_TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP = {"standard": "regular"}\n_MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER = {"regular": "standard"}\n\n# world.db is cross-domain: a few reservation rows carry cabin/trip values from\n# other skills\' vocabularies (e.g. "premium_economy"). tau2\'s schema is a closed\n# set, so coerce anything outside it to the nearest valid tau2 value on read.\n_TAU2_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy"}\n_TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES = {"one_way", "round_trip"}\n\n\ndef _world_db_path() -> Path:\n    override = os.environ.get(DB_PATH_ENV)\n    if override:\n        return Path(override)\n    for candidate in (Path.cwd() / "world.db", Path("/workspace/world.db")):\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return Path.cwd() / "world.db"\n\n\ndef _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(_world_db_path()))\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef _split_name(full: str) -> Dict[str, str]:\n    parts = (full or "").split(" ", 1)\n    return {"first_name": parts[0], "last_name": parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""}\n\n'}}

You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

num_flights = len(self.flights)\n        num_flights_instances = sum(\n            len(flight.dates) for flight in self.flights.values()\n        )\n        num_users = len(self.users)\n            "num_reservations": num_reservations,\n        }\n\n    @classmethod\n    def load(cls, path: Optional[str] = None) -> "FlightDB":\n        """Build the scoped tau2 airline tree from the unified world.db.\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat (the old db.json seed) but ignored;\n        data is read from world.db (see CUGA_WORLD_DB). Flights/reservations are\n        scoped by `source_skill=\'tau2Airline\'`; users by `skill_ids_json`.\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            flights: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flights WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                flights[r["flight_id"]] = {\n                    "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # Reservation ids per user (User.reservations is derived, not stored).\n            resv_by_user: Dict[str, list] = {}\n            reservations: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                res_flights = []\n                for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):\n                    res_flights.append(\n                        {\n                            "flight_number": fj.get("flight_number") or fj.get("flight_id"),\n                            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),\n                            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),\n                            "date": fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n                    "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n                    "flights": res_flights,\n                    "passengers": json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "payment_history": json.loads(r["payment_history_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "created_at": r["booked_at"],\n                    "total_baggages": r["total_baggages"],\n                    "nonfree_baggages": r["nonfree_baggages"],\n                    "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",\n                    "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?",\n                (f\'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%\',),\n            ):\n                users[r["user_id"]] = {\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "name": _split_name(r["name"]),\n                    "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "email": r["email"],\n                    "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "membership": _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )'}}

"""Search for direct flights\n\n        Args:\n            date: The date of the flight in the format \'YYYY-MM-DD\', such as \'2024-01-01\'.\n            origin: The origin city airport in three and (destination is None or flight.destination == destination)\n                and (date in flight.dates)\n                and (flight.dates[date].status == "available")\n                and (\n                    leave_after is None\n                    or flight.scheduled_departure_time_est >= leave_after\n                )\n            )\n            if check:\n                direct_flight =           available_seats=flight.dates[date].available_seats,\n                    prices=flight.dates[date].prices,\n                )\n                results.append(direct_flight)\n        return results\n\n    def _payment_for_update(\n        self, user: User, payment_id: str, total_price: int\n    ) -> Optional[Payment]:\n        """\n        Process payment for update reservation\n\n        Args:\n            user: The user to process payment for.\n            payment_id: The payment id to process.\n            total_price: The total price to process.\n            reservation: The reservation")\n        elif (\n            payment_method.source == "gift_card" and payment_method.amount < total_price\n        ):\n            raise ValueError("Gift card balance is not enough")\n\n Checking flight availability\n            if not isinstance(flight_date_data, FlightDateStatusAvailable):\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f"Flight {flight_number} not available on date {flight_info.date}"\n                )\n            # Checking seat availability\n            if flight_date_data.available_seats[cabin] < len(passengers):\n                raise ValueError(f"Not enough seats on flight {flight_number}")\n            # Calculate price\n            price = flight_date_data.prices[cabin]\n            # Update reservation\n            reservation.flights.append(\n                ReservationFlight(\n                    origin=flight.origin,\n                    destination=flight.destination,\n                    flight_number=flight_number,\n                    date=flight_info.date,\n                    price=price,\n                )\n            )\n            all_flights_date_data.append(flight_date_data)\n            total_price += price * len(passengers)\n\n        # Add insurance fee\n        if insurance == "yes":\n            total_price += 30 * len(passengers)\n\n        # Add baggage fee\n        total_price += 50 * nonfree_baggages\n\n        for payment_method in payment_methods:\n            payment_id = payment_method.payment_id\n            amount = payment_method.amount\n            if payment_id not in user.payment_methods:\n                raise ValueError(f"Payment method {payment_id} not found")\n\n            user_payment_method = user.payment_methods[payment_id]\n            if user_payment_method.source in {"gift_card", "certificate"}:\n                if user_payment_method.amount < amount:\n                    raise ValueError(\n                        f"Not enough balance in payment method {payment_id}"\n                    )\n\n        total_payment = sum(payment.amount for payment in payment_methods)\n        if total_payment != total_price:\n            raise ValueError(\n                f"Payment amount does not add up, total price is {total_price}, but paid {total_payment}"\n            )\n\n        # if checks pass, deduct payment\n        for payment_method in payment_methods:\n            payment_id = payment_method.payment_id\n            amount = payment_method.amount\n            user_payment_method = user.payment_methods[payment_id]\n            if user_payment_method.source == "gift_card":\n                user_payment_method.amount -= amount\n            elif user_payment_method.source == "certificate":\n                user.payment_methods.pop(payment_id)\n\n        # Update DB\n        for flight_date_data in all_flights_date_data:\n            flight_date_data.available_seats[cabin] -= len(passengers)\n        self.db.reservations[reservation_id] = reservation\n        self.db.users[user_id].reservations.append(reservation_id)\n        return reservation\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.GENERIC)\n    def calculate(self, expression: str) -> str:\n        """\n        Calculate the result of a mathematical expression.\n\n        Args:\n            expression: The mathematical expression to calculate, such as \'2 + 2\'. " for char in expression):\n            raise ValueError("Invalid characters in expression")\n        return str(round(float(eval(expression, {"__builtins__": None}, {})), 2))\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.WRITE)\n    def cancel_reservation(self, reservation_id: str) -> Reservation:\n        """\n        Cancel the whole reservation.\n\n        Args:\n            reservation_id: The reservation ID, such as \'ZFA04Y\'.\n\n        Returns:\n            The updated reservation.\n\n        Raises:\n            ValueError: If the reservation is not found.\n        """\n        reservation = self._get_reservation(reservation_id)\n        logger.debug(reservation.model_dump_json(indent=4))\n        # reverse the payment\n        refunds = []\n        for payment in reservation.payment_history:\n            refunds.append(\n                Payment(\n                    payment_id=payment.payment_id,\n                    amount=-payment.amount,\n                )\n            )\n        reservation.payment_history.extend(refunds)\n        reservation.status = "cancelled"\n        logger.debug(self._get_reservation(reservation_id).model_dump_json(indent=4))\n        # Release seats\n        logger.warning("Seats release not implemented for cancellation!!!")\n        return reservation\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.READ)\n    def get_reservation_details(self, reservation_id: str) -> Reservation:\n        """\n        Get the details of a reservation.\n\n        Args:\n            reservation_id: The reservation ID, such as \'8JX2WO\'.\n\n        Returns:\n            The reservation details.\n\n        Raises:\n            ValueError: If the reservation is not found.\n        """\n        return self._get_reservation(reservation_id)\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.READ)\n    def get_user_details(self, user_id: str) -> User:\n        """\n        Get the details of a user, including their reservations.\n\n        Args:\n            user_id: The user ID, such as \'sara_doe_496\'.\n\n        Returns:\n            The user details.\n\n        Raises:\n            ValueError: If the user is not found.\n        """\n        return self._get_user(user_id)'}}

Be careful!\n\n        Args:\n            user_id: The ID of the user to book the reservation, such as \'sara_doe_496\'.\n            amount: The amount of the certificate to send.\n\n        Returns:\n            A message indicating the certificate was sent.\n\n        Raises:\n            ValueError: If the user is not found.\n        """\n        user = self._get_user(user_id)\n\n        # add a certificate, assume at most 3 cases per task\n        for payment_id in [f"certificate_{id}" for id in self._get_new_payment_id()]:\n            if payment_id not in user.payment_methods:\n                new_payment = Certificate(\n                    id=payment_id,\n                    amount=amount,\n                    source="certificate",\n                )\n                user.payment_methods[payment_id] = new_payment\n                return f"Certificate {payment_id} added to user {user_id} with amount {amount}."\n        raise ValueError("Too many certificates")\n\n    # @is_tool(ToolType.THINK)\n    # def think(self, thought: str) -> str:\n    #     """\n    #     Use the tool to think about something.\n    #     It will not obtain new information or change the database, but just append the thought to the log.\n    #     Use it when complex reasoning or some cache memory is needed.\n\n    #     Args:\n    #         thought: A thought to think about.\n\n    #     Returns:\n    #         Empty string\n    #     """\n    #     return ""\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.GENERIC)\n    def transfer_to_human_agents(self, summary: str) -> str:\n        """\n        Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user\'s issue.\n        Only transfer if\n         - reservation.nonfree_baggages)\n\n        # Create payment\n        payment = self._payment_for_update(user, payment_id, total_price)\n        if payment is not None:\n            reservation.payment_history.append(payment)\n\n        # Update reservation\n        reservation.total_baggages = total_baggages\n        reservation.nonfree_baggages = nonfree_baggages\n\n        return reservation\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.WRITE)\n    def update_reservation_flights(\n        self,\n        reservation_id: str,\n        cabin: CabinClass,\n        flights: List[FlightInfo | dict],\n        payment_id: str,\n    ) -> Reservation:\n        """\n        Update the flight information of a reservation.\n\n\n        Args:\n            reservation_id: The reservation ID, such as \'ZFA04Y\'.\n            cabin: The cabin class of the reservation\n            flights: An array of objects containing details about each piece of flight in the ENTIRE new reservation. Even if the a flight segment is not changed, it should still be included in the array.\n            payment_id: The payment id stored in user profile, such as \'credit_card_7815826\', \'gift_card_7815826\', \'certificate_7815826\'.\n\n        Returns:\n            The updated reservation.\n\n        Raises:\n            ValueError: If the reservation is not found.\n            ValueError: If the user is not found.\n            ValueError: If the payment method is not found.\n            ValueError: If the certificate cannot be used to update reservation.\n            ValueError: If the gift card balance is not enough.\n        """\n        if all(isinstance(flight, dict) for flight in flights):\n            flights = [FlightInfo(**flight) for flight in flights]\n        reservation = self._get_reservation(reservation_id)\n        user = self._get_user(reservation.user_id)\n\n        # update flights and calculate price\n        total_price = 0\n        reservation_flights = []\n        for flight_info in flights:\n            # if existing flight, keep it\n            matching_reservation_flight = next(\n                (\n                    reservation_flight\n                    for reservation_flight in reservation.flights\n                    if reservation_flight.flight_number == flight_info.flight_number\n                    and reservation_flight.date == flight_info.date\n                    and cabin == reservation.cabin\n                ),\n                None,\n            )\n            if matching_reservation_flight:\n                total_price += matching_reservation_flight.price * len(\n                    reservation.passengers\n                )\n                reservation_flights.append(matching_reservation_flight)\n                continue\n\n            # If new flight:\n            flight = self._get_flight(flight_info.flight_number)\n            # Check flight availability\n            flight_date_data = self._get_flight_instance(\n                flight_number=flight_info.flight_number,\n                date=flight_info.date,\n            )\n            if not isinstance(flight_date_data, FlightDateStatusAvailable):\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f"Flight {flight_info.flight_number} not available on date {flight_info.date}"\n                )\n\n            # Check seat availability\n            if flight_date_data.available_seats[cabin] < len(reservation.passengers):\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f"Not enough seats on flight {flight_info.flight_number}"\n                )\n\n            # Calculate price and add to reservation\n            reservation_flight = ReservationFlight(\n                flight_number=flight_info.flight_number,\n                date=flight_info.date,\n                price=flight_date_data.prices[cabin],\n                origin=flight.origin,\n                destination=flight.destination,\n            )\n            total_price += reservation_flight.price * len(reservation.passengers)\n            reservation_flights.append(reservation_flight)\n\n        # Deduct amount already paid for reservation\n        total_price -= sum(flight.price for flight in reservation.flights) * len(\n            reservation.passengers\n        )\n\n        # Create payment\n        payment = self._payment_for_update(user, payment_id, total_price)\n        if payment is not None:\n            reservation.payment_history.append(payment)\n\n        # Update reservation\n        reservation.flights = reservation_flights\n        reservation.cabin = cabin  # This was missing from original TauBench\n\n        # Do not make flight database update here, assume it takes time to be updated # TODO: So this means that we don\'t update the seats here. What about in cancel_reservation?\n        return reservation\n\n    @is_tool(ToolType.WRITE)\n    def update_reservation_passengers(\n        self, reservation_id: str, passengers: List[Passenger | dict]\n    ) -> Reservation:\n        """\n        Update the passenger information of a reservation.\n\n        Args:\n            reservation_id: The reservation ID, such as \'ZFA04Y\'.'}}

{'id': '67563f27', 'parent_ids': ['0ab6e163', '580a6c5a', '0594cea9', '39c00b11', '203d8568', 'b6d13590', '6d827532', '57e9cd5a', '7b95e4df', 'ee2c9e2c', '4f5f7304', '3b691867', '715302bb', '9e48e57d', '8ca53be3', 'fb6280eb'], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './skills/tau2Airline/SKILL.md'}, 'tool_output': "# Airline Agent Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.\n\n## Domain Basic\n\n### User\nEach user has a profile containing:\n- user id\n- email\n- addresses\n- date of birth\n- payment methods\n- membership level\n- reservation numbers\n\nThere are three types of payment methods: **credit card**, **gift card**, **travel certificate**.\n\nThere are three membership levels: **regular**, **silver**, **gold**.\n\n### Flight\nEach flight has the following attributes:\n- flight number\n- origin\n- destination\n- scheduled departure and arrival time (local time)\n\nA flight can be available at multiple dates. For each date:\n- If the status is **available**, the flight has not taken off, available seats and prices are listed.\n- If the status is **delayed** or **on time**, the flight has not taken off, cannot be booked.\n- If the status is **flying**, the flight has taken off but not landed, cannot be booked.\n\nThere are three cabin classes: **basic economy**, **economy**, **business**. **basic economy** is its own class, completely distinct from **economy**.\n\nSeat availability and prices are listed for each cabin class.\n\n### Reservation\nEach reservation specifies the following:\n- reservation id\n- user id\n- trip type\n- flights\n- passengers\n- payment methods\n- created time\n- baggages\n- travel insurance information\n\nThere are two types of trip: **one way** and **round trip**.\n\n## Book flight\n\nThe agent must first obtain the user id from the user. \n\nThe agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.\n\nCabin:\n- Cabin class must be the same across all the flights in a reservation. \n\nPassengers: \n- Each reservation can have at most five passengers. \n- The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger. \n- All passengers must fly the same flights in the same cabin.\n\nPayment: \n- Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards. \n- The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable. \n- All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n\nChecked bag allowance: \n- If the booking user is a regular member:\n  - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- If the booking user is a silver member:\n  - 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 3 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- If the booking user is a gold member:\n  - 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 4 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.\n\nDo not add checked bags that the user does not need.\n\nTravel insurance: \n- The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.\n- The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.\n\n## Modify flight\n\nFirst, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id. \n- The user must provide their user id. \n- If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.\n\nChange flights: \n- Basic economy flights cannot be modified.\n- Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.\n- Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.\n- The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n\nChange cabin: \n- Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.\n- In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.\n- Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.\n- If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference.\n- If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.\n\nChange baggage and insurance: \n- The user can add but not remove checked bags.\n- The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.\n\nChange passengers:\n- The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.\n- Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.\n\nPayment: \n- If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n\n## Cancel flight\n\nFirst, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id. \n- The user must provide their user id. \n- If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.\n\nThe agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)\n\nIf any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.\n\nOtherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true:\n- The booking was made within the last 24 hrs\n- The flight is cancelled by airline\n- It is a business flight\n- The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.\n\nThe API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n\nRefund:\n- The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.\n\n## Refunds and Compensation\nDo not proactively offer a compensation unless the user explicitly asks for one.\n\nDo not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.\n\nAlways confirms the facts before offering compensation.\n\nOnly compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.\n\n- If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.\n\n- If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above."}}

    f["_prices"] = json.loads(f.get("cabin_prices_json") or "{}")
    all_flights.append(f)

for r in cur.fetchall():

    b["_payment_history"] = json.loads(b.get("payment_history_json") or "[]")
    all_bookings.append(b)
conn.close()

user_bookings = {}
for b in all_bookings:
    user_bookings.setdefault(b["user_id"], []).append(b)

routes = sorted(set((f["origin"], f["destination"]) for f in all_flights))

L = []

L.append("# Airline Account Review & Flight Search Report")

# ===== SECTION 1 =====

import re
# Strip leading whitespace that came from triple-quoted strings
def dedent_part(s):
    lines = s.split('\n')
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        # Remove up to 8 leading spaces (from triple-quote indentation)
        stripped = line
        if stripped.startswith('        '):
            stripped = stripped[8:]
        result.append(stripped)
    return '\n'.join(result)

import re
# Strip leading whitespace that came from triple-quoted strings
def dedent_part(s):
    lines = s.split('\n')
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        # Remove up to 8 leading spaces (from triple-quote indentation)
        stripped = line
        if stripped.startswith('        '):
            stripped = stripped[8:]
        result.append(stripped)
    return '\n'.join(result)
